subject: BCP: recovery provenance, ownership and RPO snapshot request
messages:
From: John Baxter <jbaxter@acmebank.com>
To: ava_chen@redwood.ai
Cc: security@acmebank.com
Date: 2026-06-20T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: RPO snapshots provenance and recovery ownership

Hi Ava,

As part of our SIG+SOC2 evidence collection, we need a provenance map and timestamped RPO snapshots for the Redwood service that backs our payments flow. Specifically: 

- A single-sheet mapping that shows for each recovery point (time + id): which storage volumes, KV caches (and their TTLs), and any in-memory warm-start artifacts are included.
- The measured RPO (seconds) for each point and an annotated note if the snapshot required an application-level reconciliation step.
- The owner on-call / role responsible for a live failover and the documented handoff steps.

We also need an attestation (signed by an ops lead) that the snapshots were taken and retained as stated, with cryptographic timestamps if available. Can you provide this material by end of week? If you prefer, happy to schedule a short call to walk through the format.

Thanks,
John Baxter
Senior Information Security Manager
Acme Bank

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: John Baxter <jbaxter@acmebank.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-21T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: RPO snapshots provenance and recovery ownership

John —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can deliver everything on your list. High level plan and deliverables: 

1) Provenance matrix (XLSX) — maps recovery_point_id -> volumes, KV cache names + TTLs, snapshot method (consistent filesystem vs application quiesce), and any manual reconciliation notes.
2) RPO delta snapshot (CSV) — measured RPOs under baseline and under 75% load for the payments pathway.
3) Attestation PDF — signed by our on-call lead (Marissa) and time-stamped.
4) Witness run — optional: run a canary failover with security present; we will produce logs, restore playbook traces, and timestamps.

Proposed timing: we will assemble the artifacts and send the XLSX/CSV/PDF by EOD Thursday (2026-06-24). If you want the witness run, propose a 60-minute window on Friday 2026-06-25 between 14:00-16:00 UTC.

Attachments I will include in the initial package: runbook-recovery-playbook-v3.pdf, redwood_recovery_provenance_matrix.xlsx, rpo_delta_snapshots_2026-06-20.csv. I can also attach a signed attestation as a separate PDF after the witness run if you choose to proceed.

Notes / clarifications: 
- "KV cache" in our infra refers to persistent warm-key caches persisted to an encrypted SSTable; those entries are included in the snapshot only when the warmcache flush flag is set (we will indicate that column in the matrix).
- For any application-level reconciliation steps (idempotency checks, ledger catchups) we will annotate the time estimate and the responsible team.

If that timeline works, I will send the artifacts and a calendar invite for the witness run.

Best,
Ava Chen
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: John Baxter <jbaxter@acmebank.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acmebank.com
Date: 2026-06-21T14:50:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: RPO snapshots provenance and recovery ownership

Ava —

Thanks, that sounds good. We want the witness run to exercise a warm-standby restore and a KV rehydrate sequence under simulated production traffic if possible. Couple of quick clarifying points before the artifacts: 

- Can you include the measured time to rehydrate the KV cache (seconds) and the size of the cache at snapshot time?
- For the RPO CSV, please include the measurement method and raw timestamps (UTC) for start/end so we can reconcile with our telemetry.
- Is the attestation going to include a SHA256 digest of the snapshot manifests? That would help our archival chain of custody.

We can take the Friday slot. Please send the calendar invite and the preliminary artifacts when ready.

—John

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: John Baxter <jbaxter@acmebank.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-21T18:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: RPO snapshots provenance and recovery ownership

John —

Got it. Quick confirmations we will include in the package and the witness: 

- KV cache size (MB) recorded at snapshot time and measured rehydrate duration (seconds) with median/95th percentiles.
- RPO CSV will include UTC timestamps (ISO8601), measurement method (cold vs warm restore) and the raw delta calculations.
- Attestation will include SHA256 digests for the manifests; we will provide a signed PDF attestation and a separate manifest-checksum file.

I've attached the preliminary artifacts and the invite stub for the Friday witness (witness-run-invite.ics). The full XLSX/CSV/PDF package is attached to this thread. If you prefer the attestation to be notarized, let us know and we will route to legal for a notarized sign-off (this takes additional lead time).

Attachments included: runbook-recovery-playbook-v3.pdf; redwood_recovery_provenance_matrix.xlsx; rpo_delta_snapshots_2026-06-20.csv; witness-run-invite.ics

Looking forward to the run — we'll have Marissa lead the ops walk and provide the attestation after completion.

Regards,
Ava Chen
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
